value.name: Hello Dracula Collection
value.overview: Series of children's kung-fu/comedy films featuring jiangshi (taoist hopping vampires).

parts.title: Hello Dracula
parts.overview: A troupe of young orphan street-performers tangle with the undead when a rouge jiangshi kills their beloved guardian.

parts.title: Hello Dracula 2: Son of the Vampire
parts.overview: A priest, a nun and a showman sneaks into the morgue and sees a dancing vampire and catches it. It all lead to an assault and abduction of Tien Tien.

parts.title: Hello Dracula 3: Magical Priest
parts.overview: Grandfather meets his match when he meets Master Flying Squirrel. Master Flying Squirrel captures Grandpa and transforms him into a ghostslave. Tien Tien turns to grandfather old classmate to defeat the Flying Squirrel and absolve grandfather.

parts.title: The 3-D Army
parts.overview: An evil sorcerer traps a young hopping zombie and his friend with magic. He later tries to raise an army of zombies to help carry out his nefarious schemes. It is up to a few heroes to try to stop his sinister schemes and his undead minions. (from ZMDB)

parts.title: Hello Dracula 6: Magic Girl
parts.overview: The stunning finale to the Hello Dracula series. After a series of adventures, a jealous classmate sabotages a ritual. This gives the black magician Jomoro the opportunity to return and seek his revenge against Grandpa and Tien Tien.

parts.title: King of the Children
parts.overview: The story begins when Tiarn Tiarn is about to be born. Her father was fighting the demon who has stolen lots of children. Her mother is killed and her father has taken up the fight. Years later, trying, now an adolescent, Tiarn Tiarn and her grandfather battle the demon and try to free her still, demon-possessed father.
